# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Saturday, October 31, 2026

*Saturday, Oct 31, 2026 edition. Indian markets are shut today, so all equity, index, rupee and flow numbers are Friday's (30 Oct) close. Spot gold is this morning's 07:04 IST quote; MCX gold is Friday's late-evening print (23:42 IST); Brent is Friday's settlement. Regulatory headlines only; the deep dive is in the Rules report. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. Gold had its worst day in months on Friday, and the gold-loan stocks went down with it.**
- Spot gold fell **$122.06 (−3.04%) to $3,899.33** on Friday, below $3,900 for the first time since mid-July. Silver fell 6% to an 11-month low. MCX gold was at **₹1,38,386/10g** by 23:42 IST. The triggers were hot US inflation, strong GDP, high oil and bets on a December Fed hike, and gold was heading for a monthly loss of more than 4%. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/commodities/gold-silver-prices-crash-mcx-gold-plunges-to-rs-1-lakh-silver-falls-to-rs-1-lakh-per-kg-20023794.htm), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/gold-slips-as-higher-oil-us-inflation-data-bolster-fed-hike-bets.html))
- Spot gold was **$3,875.36 (−2.93%)** at 07:04 IST today. ([exa.ai XAUUSD](https://exa.ai/library/markets/commodity/gold?currency=USD))
- Listed gold financiers fell on the day: Manappuram **−4.34%**, Muthoot Finance **−3.54%**, IIFL Finance **−6.15%**. No company-specific trigger was reported; the move lines up with the gold sell-off, but no source ties the two directly. ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-30&view=daily), [Global Banking & Finance](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/manappuram-finance-manappuram-ns-falls-2026-10-30/))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** A 3% overnight drop reduces loan-to-value headroom on gold loans written near the peak. MCX gold was ₹1,42,351/10g on Thursday and is now about 2.8% lower.


**2. Brent settled at a six-month high after a tanker was mined in the Strait of Hormuz.**
- The expiring December Brent contract settled at **$117.64 (+$2.76, +2.4%)** on 30 Oct; the January contract settled at $113.43. Brent was up 13.6% for October. ([Reuters via Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/oil-jumps-2-settles-6-month-highs-fears-escalation-iran))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Oil is the main reason markets now price a December Fed hike, and the same oil shock feeds Indian inflation. ABCL said on Friday its incremental borrowing cost rose 11 bp in Q2 and will rise another 5–10 bp in Q3 ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/aditya-birla-capital-expects-510-bps-rise-in-q3-funding-cost-creates-overlay-for-macro-risks/135378014)). NBFC bank-line and NCD costs, including Muthoot Fincorp's, are exposed to the same trend.

**3. Nomura flagged four headwinds for NBFCs and prefers urban lenders over rural ones.**
- The headwinds: weather stress on the rural economy (monsoon deficit of 13%, six states have declared drought), food inflation hitting urban customers, a longer rate-hike cycle, and rules on flexi loans and insurance. Its bear case assumes the risk-free rate rising to 7.25% from 6.25% and a 50% cut in insurance fee income from FY28. Top picks: Piramal Finance, Tata Capital, Aadhar Housing, Bajaj Finance. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/nomura-flags-four-headwinds-for-nbfcs-prefers-piramal-finance-tata-capital-aadhar-housing-finance-and-bajaj-finance-14064543.html))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** The drought states Nomura names (Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana and others) are in Muthoot Fincorp's southern catchment. Gold loans usually hold up when rural cash is short, since borrowers pledge jewellery instead of skipping payments, but a falling gold price combined with rural stress tests auction and collection numbers.

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 1.86 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 17:00 on 30 Oct, up from 1.67× on Thursday: retail 1.60×, HNI 2.56×, non-institutional 1.29×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, from a ₹4,000 cr shelf, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Friday 30 Oct close:** Sensex **74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%)**, Nifty **23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%)**. IT led (+2.32%), with Trent +5.2% on results and Infosys +3.4%. Broader markets were weak: Midcap 100 −0.93%, Smallcap 100 −1.85%. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-30th-october-2026/article71640574.ece), [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_30102026.csv))
- **Financials lagged:** Nifty Financial Services **24,712.20 (+0.03%)**, Nifty Bank 54,686.95 (−0.41%), PSU Bank −0.93%. ([NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_30102026.csv))
- **NBFC peers, NSE close 30 Oct:**
  - Manappuram Finance **₹289.00 (−4.34%)**
  - Muthoot Finance **₹2,408.60 (−3.54%)**
  - IIFL Finance **₹527.65 (−6.15%)**
  - Shriram Finance **₹823.15 (−2.13%)**
  - Bajaj Finance **₹939.10 (+0.02%)**
  - Cholamandalam **₹1,586.00 (−1.13%)**
  - LIC Housing Finance **₹493.70 (−3.95%)**, before its results came out after hours
  - ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-30&view=daily))
- **Flows:** FIIs were net buyers of **₹3,598.54 cr** and DIIs net sellers of **₹817.51 cr** (provisional). For October, FIIs sold about ₹45,162 cr and DIIs bought about ₹62,220 cr. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-return-to-buying-indian-stocks-with-rs3599-crore-inflows-diis-turn-net-sellers-20023622.htm), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/earnings/fiis-net-buy-rs-3599-crore-worth-of-indian-equities-while-diis-net-sell-rs-818-crore-on-oct-30-14064759.html))
- **Rupee:** closed at **94.93/$ (provisional), up 33 paise**. Reuters called it the rupee's best month since February, helped by RBI measures. ([BusinessLine/PTI](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-rises-33-paise-to-close-at-9493-against-us-dollar/article71644634.ece), [Business Recorder/Reuters](https://www.brecorder.com/news/40446683))
- **Coming up:** US midterms on 3 Nov; Muthoot Microfin (subsidiary) board on 5 Nov; Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCD issue closes 5 Nov.

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **RBI, 30 Oct:** one new circular that names NBFCs, **RBI/2026-27/303**, the routine UAPA Section 51A update (UNSC Taliban list, five entries amended). ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13749&Mode=0))
- **RBI data, 30 Oct:** bank credit to NBFCs grew "buoyantly" in September; growth in bank loans against gold jewellery slowed versus last year but stayed strong. ([RBI PR 2026-2027/1412](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63891))
- **RBI:** SGB 2021-22 Series VII premature-redemption price is **₹14,167 per unit** (IBJA average for 28–30 Oct), down from ₹14,213 a day earlier. The RBI central board met in Mumbai. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63897), [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63892))
- **SEBI, 30 Oct:** two circulars, an extension of the digital-accessibility compliance timeline and lighter KYC review periodicity for FPIs. Neither is NBFC-specific. ([SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0))
- **IBBI, 30 Oct:** two circulars on real-estate insolvencies (RERA compliance during CIRP; revised Form CA for homebuyer claims). ([IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **LIC Housing Finance, Q2 FY27 (after market, 30 Oct):** PAT **₹1,507 cr (+11.7%)**; NII ₹2,099 cr (+2.5%); disbursements ₹18,127 cr (+11%); loan book ₹3,26,173 cr (+5%); Stage 3 **2.05%** against 2.51% a year ago. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/lic-housing-finance-q2-profit-rises-disbursements-grow-nii-life-insurance-corp-20023770.htm), [Kalkine](https://www.kalkine.co.in/article/announcements/lic-housing-finance-nselichsgfin-what-drove-an-11-pat-rise-in-q2-fy27))
- **Aditya Birla Capital, Q2 FY27:** consolidated PAT **₹1,288 cr (+38%)**. NBFC AUM ₹1.77 trillion (+26.5%); NBFC NIM slipped to 6.00% from 6.07% as funding costs rose; RoA 2.45%. Management built an overlay for macro stress. ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/quarterly-results/aditya-birla-capital-q2-net-profit-rises-38-to-1-288-cr-on-loan-growth-126103001594_1.html), [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/aditya-birla-capital-expects-510-bps-rise-in-q3-funding-cost-creates-overlay-for-macro-risks/135378014))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** ABCL's book reprices because 70% of its loans are floating. A gold-loan book is short-tenor and fixed-rate, so for lenders such as Muthoot Fincorp margins depend on repricing at renewal rather than on a floating-rate clause.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **Crisil reaffirmed Bajaj Finance at AAA/Stable and A1+** on 30 Oct and raised its rated bank lines to ₹56,000 cr from ₹46,000 cr. ([Crisil](https://www.crisilratings.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/BajajFinanceLimited_October%2030_%202026_RR_406197.html))
- No other NBFC rating action verified for 30 Oct. Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCD is rated Crisil AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable per the issue page. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- No significant developments today. (PFC–REC merger status is in the Sector Deep Dive.)

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- No significant developments today.

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **LIC Housing:** Stage 3 down to 2.05% from 2.51% a year ago. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/lic-housing-finance-q2-profit-rises-disbursements-grow-nii-life-insurance-corp-20023770.htm))
- **ABCL NBFC:** credit provisions 0.92% of average book, against 1.03% in Q1; Stage 2 about 1%. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/aditya-birla-capital-expects-510-bps-rise-in-q3-funding-cost-creates-overlay-for-macro-risks/135378014))
- No new gold-loan asset-quality disclosures today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- No significant developments today.

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance

**1. The state-owned infra lenders are growing, but profits are mixed.**
- **REC (26 Oct):** Q2 FY27 PAT **₹3,478 cr, down 21.2%**; NII down 9% to ₹5,478 cr. Its renewable book grew 27% to about ₹86,660 cr, and non-power infrastructure and logistics is now about ₹61,637 cr, more than 10% of loans. REC also ran India's first pilot tokenised corporate bond: ₹500 cr, bids of about ₹796 cr, under SEBI's sandbox. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/rec-share-price-q2-results-net-profit-revenue-declares-interim-dividend-20019558.htm))
- **IREDA (19 Oct):** Q2 PAT ₹554 cr (from ₹549 cr); disbursements +31% to ₹10,579 cr; loan book ₹97,411 cr (+15%); net NPA 1.08% against 1.97%. ([ETEnergyworld/PTI](https://energy.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/renewable/ireda-net-profit-grows-to-554-cr-in-september-quarter/135061370))

**2. PFC–REC merger is heading to Cabinet.** RBI gave its no-objection on 15 Oct, NSE and BSE issued observation letters on 19 Oct, and the government is weighing preference shares to keep its 51% stake. The target date is 1 April 2027. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/rec-share-price-q2-results-net-profit-revenue-declares-interim-dividend-20019558.htm))

**3. IIFCL is getting ready for an IPO.** Its 28 Oct board approved restated financials for the IPO and noted the appointment of book-running lead managers. It also approved taking over illiquid and defaulted securities left in the old IIFCL Mutual Fund infrastructure debt fund, following a SEBI direction. ([NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/debt/WDM/IIFCL3_28102026183202_Outcome_of_Board_Meeting__3_.pdf))

**4. NaBFID is building a credit bureau for projects.** The Finance Ministry and RBI approved a National Infrastructure Data Platform, a single database of project data from concept to completion, drawing on NHAI, banks and Gati Shakti. RFPs for a consultant and a technology partner are out. ([ET, 21 Oct](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/infrastructure/nabfid-gets-finmin-rbi-nod-for-national-infrastructure-project-repository/articleshow/135096343.cms))

**5. Banks are lending hard into infrastructure.** RBI's September data show non-food bank credit up 19.1% year on year, industry up 19.5%, with infrastructure among the "buoyant" segments. ([RBI PR 2026-2027/1412](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63891))

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** AAA infra lenders, a merged PFC–REC and a listed IIFCL will be in the debt market all year, and wider PSU spreads would tend to lift funding costs for AA-rated issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp. Banks are lending to infrastructure and NBFCs at the same time, and long-tenor infra loans use the same bank balance-sheet room. Infrastructure build-out also supports contractor cash flow and gold-loan demand in semi-urban markets.

reports.title: What changed in the rules
reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Saturday, 31 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

One new RBI circular names NBFCs, and it's routine. **RBI/2026-27/303** (DoR.AML.REC.255/14.06.001/2026-27, 30 Oct) passes on the UNSC's amendments to five entries on the **1988 (2011) Taliban Sanctions List** under Section 51A of UAPA. It's addressed to banks, **NBFCs**, ARCs and AIFIs and points back to Chapter IX of the KYC Directions, 2025. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13749&Mode=0))
- **[NEW] [EFFECTIVE:2026-10-30]**

Nothing else from RBI, SEBI or IBBI is an NBFC rule today.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **RBI PR 2026-2027/1412 (30 Oct): Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit, September 2026.** Non-food bank credit **+19.1%** YoY. Services credit +28.3%, with NBFCs among the "buoyant" segments. Personal loans +17.3%. Growth in loans against gold jewellery "decelerated" from last year "albeit it remained strong". | RBI data release. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63891) |
| **RBI PR 2026-2027/1419 (30 Oct):** SGB 2021-22 Series VII premature-redemption price **₹14,167 per unit**, the IBJA 999 average for 28, 29 and 30 Oct | Government bond pricing. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63897) |
| **RBI PR 2026-2027/1414 (30 Oct):** 625th Central Board meeting reviewed economic conditions, DICGC and select departments | Board meeting note. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63892) |
| **SEBI circular HO/53/12/13(2)2026-ITD5-M2IPC/I/24856/2026 (30 Oct):** digital-accessibility (RPwD Act) deadline extended to **31 Jan 2027** for IAAP auditor appointment, accessibility audit and remediation | Applies to SEBI **regulated entities** (exchanges, depositories, intermediaries). [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/extension-of-timeline-with-respect-to-compliance-of-digital-accessibility-circulars_105523.html) |
| **SEBI circular (30 Oct) and PR 67/2026:** rationalised KYC review periodicity for FPIs | FPI onboarding. [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/rationalisation-of-periodicity-of-kyc-review-for-fpis_105504.html) |
| **IBBI/CIRP/110/2026 (30 Oct):** for corporate debtors with real-estate projects, the RP must comply with RERA during CIRP, may invite RERA's views on resolution plans, and must put up CIRP signboards at project sites and offices within **seven days** of appointment | Insolvency-professional conduct. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) ([PDF](https://ibbi.gov.in/uploads/legalframwork/40e3889b945ee592774ba2eb955e8eb5.pdf)) |
| **IBBI/CIRP/109/2026 (30 Oct):** revised **Form CA** (claims by financial creditors in a class). Part I is for other class creditors and Part II for homebuyers. Claims already filed don't need refiling. | Claim form. [PDF](https://ibbi.gov.in/uploads/legalframwork/84356af172f0446ac94e944711b0326e.pdf) |
| **Nomura's NBFC headwinds note** (30 Oct): flexi-loan and insurance rules named as one of four pressures | Broker research, not regulation. [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/nomura-flags-four-headwinds-for-nbfcs-prefers-piramal-finance-tata-capital-aadhar-housing-finance-and-bajaj-finance-14064543.html) |
| **RBI drafts** | Latest still **11 Sep** (KYC). [Drafts](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST):
- [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx): latest 30 Oct (RBI/2026-27/303).
- [RBI Press Releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx): latest 30 Oct.
- [RBI Drafts](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx): latest 11 Sep.
- [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0): latest 30 Oct (two circulars). [SEBI press releases](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=6&ssid=23&smid=0): latest 30 Oct (PR 67/2026).
- [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars): latest 30 Oct (IBBI/CIRP/109 and 110/2026).

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (14 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (21 days) |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| **IBC CIIRP (Chapter IV-A)** | Enacted in the IBC (Amendment) Act, 2026, but its Section 40 was not in the 26 May commencement notification. | Waiting for a commencement notice and a list of eligible lenders |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (61 days) |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (62 days) |
| **Internal Ombudsman quarterly return (Oct–Dec)** | Due by the 15th of the month after the quarter (para 16(2), IO Directions 2026). [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0) | **15 Jan 2027** (76 days) |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **15 Jan 2027:** Internal Ombudsman quarterly return for Oct–Dec due ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0)).
- **27 Apr 2027:** debenture trustees' deadline to ring-fence non-SEBI business.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.

cards.title: Gold had its worst day in months on Friday, and the gold-loan stocks went down with it.
cards.summary: Spot gold fell $122.06 (−3.04%) to $3,899.33 on Friday, below $3,900 for the first time since mid-July. Silver fell 6% to an 11-month low.
cards.impact: A 3% overnight drop reduces loan-to-value headroom on gold loans written near the peak. MCX gold was ₹1,42,351/10g on Thursday and is now about 2.8% lower.

cards.title: Brent settled at a six-month high after a tanker was mined in the Strait of Hormuz.
cards.summary: The expiring December Brent contract settled at $117.64 (+$2.76, +2.4%) on 30 Oct; the January contract settled at $113.43. Brent was up 13.6% for October.
cards.impact: Oil is the main reason markets now price a December Fed hike, and the same oil shock feeds Indian inflation. ABCL said on Friday its incremental borrowing cost rose 11 bp in Q2 and will rise another 5–10 bp in Q3 (ETBFSI). NBFC bank-line and NCD costs, including Muthoot Fincorp's, are exposed to the same trend.

cards.title: Nomura flagged four headwinds for NBFCs and prefers urban lenders over rural ones.
cards.summary: The headwinds: weather stress on the rural economy (monsoon deficit of 13%, six states have declared drought), food inflation hitting urban customers, a longer rate-hike cycle, and rules on flexi loans and insurance. Its bear case assumes the risk-free rate rising to 7.25% from 6.25% and a 50% cut in insurance fee income from FY28.
cards.impact: The drought states Nomura names (Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana and others) are in Muthoot Fincorp's southern catchment. Gold loans usually hold up when rural cash is short, since borrowers pledge jewellery instead of skipping payments, but a falling gold price combined with rural stress tests auction and collection numbers.

The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, from a ₹4,000 cr shelf, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. (Chittorgarh)

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: The state-owned infra lenders are growing, but profits are mixed.
cards.summary: REC (26 Oct): Q2 FY27 PAT ₹3,478 cr, down 21.2% ; NII down 9% to ₹5,478 cr. Its renewable book grew 27% to about ₹86,660 cr, and non-power infrastructure and logistics is now about ₹61,637 cr, more than 10% of loans. REC also ran India's first pilot tokenised corporate bond: ₹500 cr, bids of about ₹796 cr, under SEBI's sandbox.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: PFC–REC merger is heading to Cabinet.
cards.summary: RBI gave its no-objection on 15 Oct, NSE and BSE issued observation letters on 19 Oct, and the government is weighing preference shares to keep its 51% stake. The target date is 1 April 2027.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: IIFCL is getting ready for an IPO.
cards.summary: Its 28 Oct board approved restated financials for the IPO and noted the appointment of book-running lead managers. It also approved taking over illiquid and defaulted securities left in the old IIFCL Mutual Fund infrastructure debt fund, following a SEBI direction.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: NaBFID is building a credit bureau for projects.
cards.summary: The Finance Ministry and RBI approved a National Infrastructure Data Platform, a single database of project data from concept to completion, drawing on NHAI, banks and Gati Shakti. RFPs for a consultant and a technology partner are out.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: Banks are lending hard into infrastructure.
cards.summary: RBI's September data show non-food bank credit up 19.1% year on year, industry up 19.5%, with infrastructure among the "buoyant" segments. (RBI PR 2026-2027/1412)
cards.impact: AAA infra lenders, a merged PFC–REC and a listed IIFCL will be in the debt market all year, and wider PSU spreads would tend to lift funding costs for AA-rated issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp. Banks are lending to infrastructure and NBFCs at the same time, and long-tenor infra loans use the same bank balance-sheet room. Infrastructure build-out also supports contractor cash flow and gold-loan demand in semi-urban markets.
